goal: Change post style every 2 weeks, keep styles that perform better, build a solid base of proven styles.
metrics_source: Windsor.ai instagram connector (media_reach, media_saved, media_shares, media_like_count, media_comments_count). Zapier can only read likes and comments.

rules.per_post: reach; engagements = likes + comments + saves + shares; engagement_rate = engagements / reach
rules.per_cycle: median reach per post and median engagement rate
rules.compare_to: the previous cycle (the account is growing, so adjacent cycles are the fairest comparison)
rules.keep_style_if: median reach and median engagement rate are both at least as good as the previous cycle, and at least one is 20% or more better
rules.low_confidence: if median reach is under 50, mark the result low confidence and keep testing rather than locking a style in
rules.solid_base: once 3 styles are in the base, or after 12 weeks, mix the base styles and test a new challenger every other cycle

style_library.A: Bold cards: big type on solid brand colour, short checklists (posts 1 to 16)
style_library.B: Carousels: 4 to 6 slide tips for gym owners, first slide is a hook
style_library.C: Big statement: one short line or one number, huge type, dark background, almost no other text
style_library.D: Website mockups: phone and laptop frames showing gym site designs, before and after concepts
style_library.E: Short Reels: 7 to 10 second animated text videos (needs video rendering, skip if not possible)
style_library.F: Personal and fight story: Charles's real fight history and photos (needs photos from Charles)
